instruction: Candid street photograph, full-length shot. On a city crosswalk, the woman with long brown hair in a green coat (R1) stands on the left, facing right and smiling. Opposite her, the woman with short dark hair in a red sweater (R2) stands on the right, facing left and laughing. The woman in the green coat and the woman in the red sweater hold hands between them at waist level. The background features blurred buildings and parked cars under soft, diffused daylight.
